## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 207 captures during May 2023. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below. No further activity information is included in this report.

The capture total reflects the work completed at the site during the month. It is presented alongside the quality and grading results to support routine monitoring of service delivery.

## Image quality

There were 4 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 1.9 per cent. This measure indicates the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. The result is reported for the full set of activity recorded during May 2023.

## Grading

A total of 57 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This is the midpoint wait for grading across the reported results and is presented with the referable total for the month. Together, these measures summarise the grading outcome and timeliness recorded for East City Eye Clinic during May 2023.
